name: Comac
legalEntityNote: Comac S.p.A. is the Italian company identified by the official company-data page. Distributors, destination-market importers, service partners and contracting sellers can hold separate responsibilities.
headline: Comac professional cleaning machines, Italian company and buyer checks
description: A source-backed profile of Comac S.p.A., its Italian cleaning-equipment history, floorcare portfolio, autonomous SELF.Y platform, international channel and procurement checks.
metaDescription: Comac profile: Italian company, scrubber dryers, sweepers, SELF.Y autonomous cleaning, international channels and buyer verification.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Comac. Company history and product-page statements do not establish the manufacturer, origin, importer, conformity route or warranty provider for every configured machine and market.
headquarters: Santa Maria di Zevio, Verona, Italy

ownership.summary: Official materials identify Comac S.p.A. as the company behind the Comac professional-cleaning portfolio. The reviewed official sources do not name a parent company, and they do not establish an ownership relationship with Fimap S.p.A.; the two legal entities should therefore not be merged or treated as parent and subsidiary.

leadership.name: Giancarlo Ruffo
leadership.context: Comac's official history says Giancarlo Ruffo and Domenico Accadia created Costruzione Macchine, shortened to Comac, in 1974.

leadership.name: Domenico Accadia
leadership.context: Comac's official history identifies mechanic Domenico Accadia as the co-founder who developed the original Italian floor-scrubber venture with Giancarlo Ruffo.

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber dryers
productPortfolio.positioning: Walk-behind and ride-on floor scrubbers cover commercial and industrial cleaning duties across multiple machine sizes.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match cleaning path, tank volume, floor type, brush system, battery, gradient and realistic productivity to the site.

productPortfolio.name: Sweepers and street sweepers
productPortfolio.positioning: Indoor and outdoor sweepers extend the range from compact facilities to heavier industrial and urban applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify debris type, filtration, unloading, traction, emissions or road approval and operator requirements for the exact configuration.

productPortfolio.name: SELF.Y autonomous scrubber
productPortfolio.positioning: SELF.Y is presented as a cobot floor scrubber for airports, supermarkets, offices, healthcare and other large spaces.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Require a live site trial covering mapping, obstacle behavior, edge cleaning, recovery, data access, charging and manual fallback.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum cleaners and single-disc machines
productPortfolio.positioning: Supporting floorcare machines broaden the range beyond mechanized scrubbing and sweeping.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm filtration, accessories, chemicals, electrical standard, consumables and local parts availability.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Comac's official history traces the business to Italian production of floor scrubbers beginning in 1974 and documents early production lines in the Verona area.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company history and early Comac production, not every current model or component
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the exact machine's manufacturer plate, production site, serial number, country of origin and conformity declaration.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official SELF.Y page publishes model-level applications and technical material for the autonomous scrubber.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: SELF.Y product family and the configuration offered in the destination market
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Freeze hardware, software, safety options, battery, accessories and destination-market certification in the quotation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Comac's product navigation separates scrubbers, sweepers, autonomous machines, vacuums and single-disc machines into distinct families.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Official portfolio taxonomy rather than a claim of one manufacturing route
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize one product family's origin or supplier arrangement to the rest of the portfolio.

marketsChannels.evidence: Comac publishes a worldwide contact route and invites companies to apply to become distributors.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized distributor, importing entity, contracting seller and service territory for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: The SELF.Y page positions the machine for airports, supermarkets, offices and healthcare facilities.
marketsChannels.scope: Reference applications for SELF.Y, not guaranteed suitability
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Conduct a supervised trial on the buyer's actual floors, traffic conditions and cleaning schedule before award.

marketsChannels.evidence: Comac provides product-specific pages and downloadable documentation through its official website.
marketsChannels.scope: Published information available for named models
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Archive the exact-market manual, parts list, warranty, software terms and compliance documents that govern the purchased machine.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Comac competes as a broad Italian professional-cleaning equipment supplier spanning conventional and autonomous floorcare. Buyers should compare delivered configuration, local service capacity and lifecycle cost rather than relying on portfolio breadth alone.

developments.title: Comac marks 50 years from its 1974 origin
developments.summary: The official history presents five decades of product and company development in professional floor cleaning.

developments.title: Costruzione Macchine is created
developments.summary: Comac says Giancarlo Ruffo and Domenico Accadia created Costruzione Macchine, shortened to Comac, to produce floor scrubbers in Italy.
